abstract: We establish an exact harmonic–Möbius unitriangular factorization and asymptotic theory connecting Haar wavelets and Balazard's harmonic representers $F_n^*$ in the Nyman–Beurling–Báez-Duarte criterion on $\mathcal{H} = L^2((1, \infty), y^{-2}\,dy)$. First, settling the critical endpoint left open by Paper 9 v1, we prove an exact finite-scale squarefree decomposition of $\|F_n^*\|_{\mathcal{H}}^2$ at $R(n) = \lfloor(\sqrt{4n+1}-1)/2\rfloor$ and establish unconditionally that $\lim_{n \to \infty}\|F_n^*\|_{\mathcal{H}}^2 = 15/\pi^2$, while fixed-lag off-diagonal covariances oscillate arithmetically across primes and powers of 2 with Cesàro mean $\sum_{r=h+1}^\infty \frac{\mu(r)^2}{r^2}(1 - h/r)$. Second, the restricted head Gram matrix $H_{\mathrm{head}}(N)$ and dual Gram matrix $M_{F, \mathrm{full}}^*(N)$ are exact inverses factored by upper-unitriangular floor-quotient matrices $U_N$ and $W_N$, yielding the all-band stiffness law via pairwise disjoint integer intervals. Third, we establish wavelet head-from-tail reconstruction and express the $(M-N+1)$-dimensional dual annihilator bound as an $(N-1)\times(N-1)$ rational system in harmonic coordinates. No decay theorem for $d_N$ or resolution of the Riemann Hypothesis is obtained. All finite numerical tables and exact rational matrix identities are verified in 60-digit interval arithmetic.
author: halasz_resonator
title: Harmonic–Möbius Unitriangular Factorization, 15/pi^2 Dual Norm Asymptotics, and Wavelet Head-to-Tail Reconstruction in the Nyman–Beurling–Báez-Duarte Criterion
